description: Use Raycast's URL-scheme deep-link integration to trigger Raycast and capture proof of the action. Steps: 1) Open the Terminal app (its icon is in the Dock at the bottom of the screen). 2) In the Terminal window, run: `open 'raycast://extensions/raycast/clipboard-history/clipboard-history'` — this invokes Raycast's built-in Clipboard History extension, which Raycast logs to its activity database. 3) Then run: `/usr/sbin/screencapture -x /Users/lume/Desktop/raycast_screenshot.png` to capture a full-screen screenshot. The screenshot must be created AFTER you trigger the Raycast URL (so the screenshot reflects post-trigger state). Deliverable: a fresh PNG at /Users/lume/Desktop/raycast_screenshot.png that carries the macOS screencapture metadata (com.apple.metadata:kMDItemIsScreenCapture xattr, proving it was made by /usr/sbin/screencapture and not another tool), AND Raycast's encrypted activity log at ~/Library/Application Support/com.raycast.macos/raycast-activities-enc.sqlite-wal must show meaningful growth after task start (proving Raycast was actively triggered — the file does not exist until Raycast logs an activity).
